title: Says "have fun" when you make plans
old_caption: Leo got invited out and Scorpio said go, have fun, tell me everything later, then cracked open a book. Secure is a cozy look. What do you do on a solo night in?

title: Does the dishes when you cook
old_caption: Cancer cooked, so Sagittarius grabbed the yellow gloves before anyone could argue. "I want to" is doing a lot of work here. In your house, does the cook ever wash up?

title: Keeps your secrets
old_caption: Gemini asked what Libra said. Capricorn zipped it. Libra beamed from across the room. Being someone people can tell things to is the flag. Who's the vault in your friend group?

title: Remembers the thing you said once
old_caption: Virgo mentioned loving tangerines one time in October. Aquarius showed up with a whole crate and a bow. Some people actually listen. What's a tiny thing someone remembered about you?

title: Chooses you on ordinary days too
old_caption: The last door of the calendar: no big plans, just Pisces and Taurus splitting the last piece of toast on a plain Tuesday in January. That's the green flag. Which of the 24 was your favourite?

title: Aries, first snow, 3 AM idea
old_caption:
First snow at 3 AM and you want to text them right now?
Invite them for tomorrow. The snow will wait.

title: Taurus, 3 AM toast, too comfy to date?
old_caption:
Ever lie awake wondering if you're too comfy to date?
Cozy alone is a great place to choose from, not hide in.

title: Gemini counts snowflakes, not sheep
old_caption:
Can't sleep, so you think up every question for your crush?
Save them for coffee and ask one at a time.

title: Cancer knits a scarf after two dates
old_caption:
Two dates in and already knitting them a scarf?
A scarf is warmth, not a promise. Give it lightly.

title: Leo rehearses the party entrance
old_caption:
Rehearsing your party entrance at 3 AM?
Skip the big moment. Walk over and say hi.
